attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 10 had no etcd package, so binaries were fetched from upstream GitHub release, wired into systemd, and firewalld's built-in etcd-client/etcd-server services were enabled). Loaded application keys under /app/*, confirmed replication and a healthy baseline. Simulated node3's member being permanently lost (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory), removed the stale member via node1/node2 while preserving 2-node quorum and verifying data was still intact, then added a new node3 member and bootstrapped a fresh etcd instance there in existing-cluster mode. Cluster returned to 3 healthy members with all application keys replicated onto the rebuilt node3. Finally, executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (systemd reboot), confirming boot_id changes and full cluster health/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
